title: pkix-profiles dep on pkix-profiles-cabf for deprecated re-exports
description: pkix-profiles takes a runtime dep on pkix-profiles-cabf solely to serve deprecated re-exports (WebPkiProfile, SmimeProfile, CodeSigningProfile, sc081_validity_cap). The dependency direction is inverted: foundational crate depends on overlay crate. This coupling exists only for a one-release deprecation bridge (dropping in 0.4.0). Any consumer of pkix-profiles pulls in pkix-profiles-cabf transitively. Location: /home/mark/PROJECT/PKIX/pkix-profiles/Cargo.toml line 25.
